decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product feed for actual backpacks, as many items provided were camping accessories such as tents, stoves, or coffee pots. My consideration set focuses on a variety of specialized functional backpacks: a tactical camo day pack (prod_backpacks_171), a hydration-focused hiking pack (prod_backpacks_078), a large capacity minimalist hiking pack (prod_backpacks_041), a specialized cooler backpack (prod_backpacks_067), and a fishing tackle backpack (prod_backpacks_082). I selected the Gelindo 18L-Hiking Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) as the final choice because it holds the highest rating (4.7) with a high review volume, and specifically includes a well-regarded hydration bladder and functional pockets for a very reasonable price point.
